         announces the visitor's real state via the consent-sync hub

         Google tags until that update arrives. 2000ms covers OneTrust
         fetching its geolocation + config from its CDN on slow connections;

      // Note: This is safe to leave in production code as it only activates when those URL parameters are present.

      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      if (urlParams.get('otstate') && urlParams.get('otcountry')) {
        var stateCode = urlParams.get('otstate').toUpperCase();
        var countryCode = urlParams.get('otcountry').toUpperCase();

        window['ga-disable-G-VCR72TVLZ6'] = builderEditing || !analytics;

        if (typeof window.clarity === 'function') {
          window.clarity('consentv2', {
            ad_Storage: targeting ? 'granted' : 'denied',
            analytics_Storage: analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
          });
          if (!analytics) {
            // Erases Clarity's cookies and ends the recorded session.
            window.clarity('consent', false);
          }
        }

        if (!analytics) {
          // builderSessionId included ahead of CR-63334 (Builder SDK gating):
          // the cookie can persist from before the opt-out, and some SDK
          // versions re-set it on SPA navigation.
          purgeCookiesByPrefix([
            '_ga',
            '_gid',
            '_gat',
            '_clck',
            '_clsk',
            'builderSessionId',

        if (!functional) {
          // VWO: halts tracking and clears its cookies, leaving only its
          // opt-out marker so it stays off on future visits.
          window.Wingify = window.Wingify || [];
          window.Wingify.push(['optOutVisitor']);
          // Bizible (_biz_*) and Marketo Munchkin (_mkto_trk) have no runtime
          // stop API; removing their ID cookies de-identifies the session.
          purgeCookiesByPrefix(['_vwo', '_vis_opt_', '_biz_', '_mkto_trk']);
        } else {
          // Re-granting Functional must let VWO resume: its opt-out markers
          // persist by design and would otherwise keep the visitor excluded
          // from experiments forever. VWO's own boot (re-activated by OneTrust
          // in parallel with this callback) can race the first deletion and
          // re-assert the marker, so clear again after it settles; VWO then
          // resumes on the next page load.
          var clearVwoOptOutMarkers = function () {
            deleteCookieEverywhere('_vis_opt_out');
            deleteCookieEverywhere('_wingify_out');
          };
          clearVwoOptOutMarkers();
          setTimeout(clearVwoOptOutMarkers, 3000);
        }

        if (!targeting) {
          purgeCookiesByPrefix([
            '_gcl_',
            '_fbp',
            '_fbc',
            '_uetsid',
            '_uetvid',
            '__ar_v4',
            '__adroll',
          ]);
        }

        // Lets the Angular app react to consent changes for vendors it owns
        // (consumed by CR-63334's Builder SDK gating).
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('cr-consent-changed', {
            detail: {
              analytics: analytics,
              functional: functional,
              targeting: targeting,
            },
          }),
        );

        // one reload as defense-in-depth: Bizible and Marketo have no stop
        // API, and a fresh page load is the only way to fully stop their
        // already-running scripts. Scoped to withdrawals only — initial load
        // and opt-ins never reload, and after the reload previousGroups
        // starts empty, so no reload loop is possible.
        // C0005 (Social Media) exists in our OneTrust config with no cookies
        // categorized yet; included so a withdrawal still stops any scripts
        // that may be assigned to it later.
        var withdrew = ['C0002', 'C0003', 'C0004', 'C0005'].some(
          function (group) {
            return previousGroups.indexOf(group) > -1 && !otGroupActive(group);
          },
        );
        previousGroups = window.OnetrustActiveGroups;
        if (withdrew) {
          window.location.reload();
        }
      }
